LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 1.3.1 WORD CLASSES: NOUNS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to identify items by name?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the different types of nouns from a print or digital text
2. use different types of nouns in sentences
3. appreciate the role of correct grammar in written and spoken communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 1.3.1 WORD CLASSES: NOUNS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the different types of nouns from a print or digital text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use different types of nouns in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of correct grammar in written and spoken communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to identify items by name?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the different types of nouns from a print or digital text
2. use different types of nouns in sentences
3. appreciate the role of correct grammar in written and spoken communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
